description: This file is a shell script designed to launch a web browser on an HTML page describing a git command. It handles browser selection, configuration, and execution, and appears to be used as a utility within a larger git-related project.

methods.name: valid_custom_tool
methods.description: Checks if a custom browser tool command is configured for the provided tool name.

methods.name: valid_tool
methods.description: Validates if the provided browser name or tool is recognized and supported.

methods.name: init_browser_path
methods.description: Initializes the path to the browser executable based on configuration or defaults.
